sub_sections.title: Information
sub_sections.description_text:
This is a guide on how to obtain all Halo MCC multiplayer achievements, be them Matchmade, Custom, Firefight or Forge. The explanation will be the easiest way to obtain them so even if an achievement can be unlocked in matchmade games I may list an easier method to achieve it in a custom game.

I am not planning on adding Spartan Ops achievements here even though they technically count as Custom Multiplayer games.

If I have missed an achievement please let me know in the comments section as well as any over relevant information or feedback you have! :D

[h1]Guide Overview:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Halo Reach
[*] Halo CE
[*] Halo 2 - Classic Multiplayer
[*] Halo 2 Anniversary - Matchmade
[*] Halo 2 Anniversary - Custom games
[*] Halo 2 Anniversary Blast Soda Cans
[*] Halo 3
[*] Halo 3 Multiplayer Skulls
[*] Halo 4
[*] Cross-game
[*] Multiplayer wins
[/list]

sub_sections.title: Halo 2A Custom Games [previewimg=30049091;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;25 red.jpg][/previewimg]
sub_sections.description_text:
[i][b]Note: Some of these achievements can be obtained and have progression gained towards in matchmade games as well.[/b][/i]
[code]
[previewimg=19961389;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;invaders.jpg][/previewimg]
-Invaders Repelled:
"Halo 2A MP: In King of the Hill, kill 5 opponents within your controlled hill."
[/code]
Can be achieved on any map and in custom or matchmade games. While you are in your controlled hill kill an enemy opponent who is outside of the hill 5 times. Despite not mentioning this in the achievement description, this needs to be done in a single game of KOTH. Each correct kill will grant a Hill Defence medal.

[code]
[previewimg=19961454;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;triple threat.jpg][/previewimg]
-Triple Threat:
"Halo 2A MP: In Ricochet, pass once, score once, and kill at least one enemy in the same match."
[/code]
For this achievement you will need 2 other people if trying to achieve it in a custom game and make sure one player is on the opposite team and one is on your team. You must score the ball once, kill the enemy player once and pass the ball to your teammate once for the achievement to unlock. Can also be obtained in matchmade games.

[code]
[previewimg=19961488;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;bombing run.jpg][/previewimg]
-Bombing Run:
"Halo 2A MP: In Assault, take, plant, and score from the bomb spawn without dying or dropping it."
[/code]
Unlocked by taking, planting, and scoring from the bomb spawn without dying or dropping the bomb. This can be unlocked in custom games as well as matchmade games.

[code]
[previewimg=19961495;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;cold fusion.jpg][/previewimg]
-Cold Fusion:
"Halo 2A MP: Kill an opponent by detonating a Fusion Coil."
[/code]
On some multiplayer maps there are explosive canisters called Fusion Coils. Shoot one of these canisters next to a player to kill them and unlock this achievement. Lockdown and Stonetown are good maps for this.

[code]
[previewimg=19961536;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;counter.jpg][/previewimg]
-Counter-Sniped:
"Halo 2A MP: With a Sniper Rifle or Beam Rifle kill an enemy that was zoomed in."
[/code]
Unlocked by killing an enemy player in a Halo 2: Anniversary multiplayer match with a Sniper Rifle or a Beam Rifle while that player is zoomed in. Can be obtained in custom or matchmade games.

[code]
[previewimg=19961556;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;emine.jpg][/previewimg]
-Eminent Domain:
"Halo 2A MP: In Territories, control any 3 Territories simultaneously for 30 seconds."
[/code]
Load up a custom game of Territories (3 plots) and control all 3 zones for 30 seconds and the achievement will unlock. You do not even need a second player for this.

[code]
[previewimg=19961576;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;stayin.jpg][/previewimg]
-Stayin' Alive:
"Halo 2A MP: In Juggernaut, survive as the Juggernaut for 30 seconds."
[/code]
You can do this in a custom game by your self. Just load up a game of Juggernaut and survive for 30 seconds.

[code]
[previewimg=19961586;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;goose.jpg][/previewimg]
-The Goose is Loose:
"Halo 2A MP: Get 25 kills with the Gungoose in multiplayer."

[previewimg=19961585;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;top.jpg][/previewimg]
-Top Gungoose:
"Halo 2A MP: Get a kill with the Gungoose while airborne."
[/code]
For 'The Goose is Loose' achievement you need a total of 25 kills with the Gungoose in matchmade and/or custom games.

For the achievement 'Top Gungoose' you can get it in a custom game on the map Bloodline with a friend. This method here by Halo Completionist is very easy: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Is-9aM9F3CQ

[code]
[previewimg=19961613;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;shook.jpg][/previewimg]
-Shook the Hornet's Nest:
"Halo 2A MP: Get 30 kills with the Hornet in multiplayer."
[/code]
This achievement is easily obtained on the map Bloodline. You can farm this in custom games with a friend or in matchmade games.

[code]
[previewimg=19961622;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;skeet.jpg][/previewimg]
-Skeet Shooter:
"Halo 2A MP: Killed 15 opponents that were airborne from a Man Cannon."
[/code]
This achievement can also be obtained on Bloodline as both bases have man cannons. Alternatively this can be earned in many matchmade and custom matches as lots of maps have man cannons. SWAT may make this easier as a headshot is an instant kill.

[code]
[previewimg=19961639;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;red.jpg][/previewimg]
-Red vs. Blue:
"Halo 2A MP: Win 10 matches on Bloodline in multiplayer."
[/code]
This achievement can actually be obtained by loading into a custom game of Bloodline and then ending the game straight away 10 times by yourself.

[code]
[previewimg=19961651;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;cold as ice.jpg][/previewimg]
-Cold as Ice
"Halo 2A MP: On Lockdown, kill an opponent with the hanging ice."
[/code]
Can be obtained in a custom game with a friend by loading up the map Lockdown and shooting the icicle while they are standing below it. There are 3 icicles available.

[code]
[previewimg=19961684;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;power play.jpg][/previewimg]
-Power Play:
"Halo 2A MP: On Warlord, get 5 active camouflage power ups in a single game."
[/code]
Load up a custom game on 'Warlord' with the game type set to Slayer and wait standing next to the centre area where the active camo power ups spawn. Can be obtained in a solo custom game. Here is a video by Halo Completionist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rBeo6z0RY5c

[code]
[previewimg=19961704;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;wetwork.jpg][/previewimg]
-Wetwork:
"Halo 2A MP: On Shrine in CTF, activate the enemy base waterfall and, before it stops, grab the flag."
[/code]
Load up a custom game of Shrine on Capture the Flag game type and head to the opposite side of the map from where you spawn. Shoot the orange crystal at the top of the enemy base and then grab the flag before the water stops. This can be unlocked in a solo custom game. Here is a video by Halo Completionist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pd-_uZFFPyU

[code]
[previewimg=19961718;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;grand theft halo.jpg][/previewimg]
-Grand Theft Halo:
"Halo 2A MP: In one match, steal a total of 5 occupied vehicles from opponents."
[/code]
This can be unlocked in a custom game with a friend. I recommend loading up the map Bloodline and hijacking a friend on a gungoose or ghost. Do this 5 times in one match for the achievement.

[code]
[previewimg=19961740;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;blown.jpg][/previewimg]
-Blown Out of the Sky:
"Halo 2A MP: Blow up the Banshee or Hornet in flight while piloted, with the Rocket Launcher."
[/code]
For this achievement load up a match of Bloodline with a friend and let them fly a Hornet to you. Make sure you have a Rocket Launcher and simply blow them up for the achievement.

[code]
[previewimg=19961805;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;put up your dukes.jpg][/previewimg]
-Put Up Your Dukes:
"Halo 2A MP: Get 25 melee kills in multiplayer."
[/code]
Simply get 25 melee kills in matchmade and/or custom games.

[code]
[previewimg=19961766;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;tour of duty.jpg][/previewimg]
-Tour of Duty:
"Halo 2A MP: Complete a game in every one of the 6 updated Anniversary MP maps."
[/code]
You can simply load into 6 multiplayer maps and end the game to progress this achievement but if you are going for all achievements you will unlock this naturally.

sub_sections.title: Halo 4 [previewimg=30049123;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;25 taste test.jpg][/previewimg]
sub_sections.description_text:
[code]
[previewimg=20267737;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;going inter.jpg][/previewimg]
-Going International:
"Halo 4: Complete a match on at least 8 different multiplayer maps."
[/code]
Pretty self-explanatory. You can load up different maps in custom games and then end the game straight away.
[code]
[previewimg=20267739;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;taste test.jpg][/previewimg]
-Taste Test:
"Halo 4: Complete a match on at least 4 different game types in multiplayer."
[/code]
Can be down with the achievement above. Load up custom games with different game types selected. Just change the game type in the custom game selection i.e. Capture the Flag, Slayer etc.

sub_sections.title: Halo 3 [previewimg=30049112;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;25 msn on the.jpg][/previewimg]
sub_sections.description_text:
[b]All these achievements can be unlocked in Custom Games and do not have to be achieved in Matchmade games.[/b]
[code]
[previewimg=19985904;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;hippo hero.jpg][/previewimg]
-Hippo Hero:
"Halo 3: Who DARED to discard this brave animal?"
[/code]
This Hippo can be found on the map Foundry. This achievement is probably easier done on Forge although you can find it normally without editing on Forge. Here is a video by Halo Completionist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfZqghlUEZA
[code]
[previewimg=19985905;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;msn on the.jpg][/previewimg]
-Man on the Moon:
"Halo 3: He's watching you."
[/code]
This achievement can be unlocked on the multiplayer map Standoff. You want to make sure you have access to a Sniper Rifle so you could change the custom game options or game type to Snipers. Here is a video guide by Halo Completionist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=40UT7Xfo_xw
[code]
[previewimg=19985899;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;sounds famillar.jpg][/previewimg]
-Sounds Familiar:
"Halo 3: This stuff is your history!"
[/code]
This easter egg is located on the multiplayer map High Ground. Here is a video guide by Halo Completionist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9npwQNZrEf4
[code]
[previewimg=19985900;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;elder signs.jpg][/previewimg]
-Elder Signs:
"Halo 3: View 2 different sigils on Valhalla."
[/code]
This achievement is unlocked by viewing two of the messages (located on the metal wall on the far side between the two towers) on multiplayer map Valhalla on two of the following days:
[list]
[*] January 1st - New Year's Day
[*] April 22nd - Earth Day
[*] May 5th - Cinco De Mayo
[*] July 4th - Marathon reference
[*] July 7th - Bungie Day
[*] October 31st - Halloween
[*] November 11th - Veteran's Day
[*] December 25th - Christmas
[/list]
If you do not wish to wait for one of these dates you can change your PC's date and achieve it that way.
[code]
[previewimg=19985907;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;world.jpg][/previewimg]
-World Traveler:
"Halo 3: Complete a match on at least 8 different multiplayer maps."
[/code]
Pretty self-explanatory. You can load up different maps in custom games and then end the game straight away.
[code]
[previewimg=19985908;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;just brow.jpg][/previewimg]
-Just Browsing:
"Halo 3: Complete a match on at least 4 different game types in multiplayer."
[/code]
Can be down with the achievement above. Load up custom games with different game types selected. Just change the game type in the custom game selection i.e. Capture the Flag, Slayer etc.

sub_sections.title: Halo 2A Matchmade [previewimg=30049102;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;25 ninja redux.jpg][/previewimg]
sub_sections.description_text:
[h1]All these achievements (apart from Double Down and Shields Up!) can be earned in 1v1 matchmade matches with a friend. This is done by both hitting search with only 1v1 and Halo 2A multiplayer selected in the multiplayer search queue.[/h1]

[code]
[previewimg=19961852;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;double down.jpg][/previewimg]
-Double Down:
"Halo 2A MP: In Anniversary multiplayer, receive 2 or more Double Kill medals."
[/code]
For this achievement you need two double kill medals in a single game of Halo 2A multiplayer. Despite this achievement being obtainable in custom games, if you don't play custom games it will come a lot easier in matchmade games and you won't need to find people to do it with.

[code]
[previewimg=19961854;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;flaming ninja.jpg][/previewimg]
-Flaming Ninja Anniversary:
"Halo 2A MP: Kill an opponent that has the Ninja Redux achievement in Anniversary matchmaking."
[/code]
For this achievement you must kill someone with the 'Ninja Redux' achievement in a matchmade game. You will likely find and kill someone who has the 'Ninja Redux' achievement if you play a couple of games of Halo 2A multiplayer.

[code]
[previewimg=19961857;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;ninja redux.jpg][/previewimg]
-Ninja Redux:
"Halo 2A MP: Kill 5 people with melee from behind in Anniversary matchmaking."
[/code]
This achievement is awarded for getting a total of 5 Beat Down medals (meleeing an enemy player in the back) across any matchmade Halo 2A games. This isn't too hard nor is it too time consuming.

[code]
[previewimg=19961855;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;legend slayer.jpg][/previewimg]
-Legend Slayer:
"Halo 2A MP: Kill an opponent that has the Legendary Anniversary achievement."
[/code]
This achievement is earned for killing a player in Halo 2A multiplayer that has the Legendary Anniversary achievement (which is unlocked for beating the Halo 2 Campaign on Legendary difficulty). Although this achievement is obtainable in custom games it is easily obtainable in matchmade games, even more so than a custom game.

[code]
[previewimg=19961862;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;warden.jpg][/previewimg]
-Warden:
"Halo 2 MP: In Classic or Anniversary matchmaking, stop the killing spree of another player."
[/code]
This is unlocked for ending someones killing spree (earning a Killjoy medal) in a matchmade game of Halo 2A. Will unlock with natural play of Halo 2 multiplayer. Note that this can actually be obtained in Classic multiplayer as well.

[code]
[previewimg=19961863;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;zealot.jpg][/previewimg]
-Zealot:
"Halo 2A MP: In Anniversary matchmaking, win 10 games as an Elite."
[/code]
This achievement is earned for winning 10 matchmade multiplayer games while playing as an Elite. To play as an Elite you need to select it as your preferred species in the customisation page.

[code]
[previewimg=19961866;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;mvp.jpg][/previewimg]
-MVP:
"Halo 2A MP: Finished as the top player on the winning team in a matchmade game."
[/code]
Self explanatory really. Be the top of the leaderboard on the winning team in a matchmade game of Halo 2A.

[code]
[previewimg=19961868;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;shields up.jpg][/previewimg]
-Shields Up!:
"Halo 2A MP: On Zenith, personally activate the center energy shield 3 times in one matchmade game."
[/code]
To activate the centre shield on the map Zenith you must make your way to one of the few control boxes and hold 'E'. This will activate it for a short time. You must do this 3 times in one matchmade game so try camping near areas where you can activate the shield.
Here is a video by Halo Completionist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XAFJj0kaV2U

[code]
[previewimg=19961812;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;decotrated.jpg][/previewimg]
-Decorated Warrior:
"Halo 2A MP: Get awarded at least 10 different medals in one multiplayer game."
[/code]
This isn't very hard and will come with natural progression in Halo 2A multiplayer games. You can also farm this in custom games with friends if you want. Examples of medals include double kill, killing spree, headshot etc.

[code]
[previewimg=19961859;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;roadkill.jpg][/previewimg]
-Roadkill Rampage:
"Halo 2A MP: In Anniversary matchmaking, earn a total of 100 Splatter medals."
[/code]
For this achievement you need to obtain 100 splatter medals in Halo 2A matchmade games. Splatter medals are earned for running over or hitting enemies with a moving vehicle you are driving/piloting. This one is grindy so good luck. :D

[b]1v1 Method:[/b] This can be earned 1v1 by you and a friend queuing up in separate lobbies at the same time. Only the map Lockdown will work. The player who is earning the achievement will need to shoot the ice and have the other player jump into the falling ice which will trick the game into awarding a Splatter medal. The ice will respawn after a short amount of time.
[previewicon=30049064;sizeThumb,inline;120px-H4_-_Splatter.png][/previewicon]

[code]
[previewimg=19961860;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;rock and coil.jpg][/previewimg]
-Rock and Coil Hit Back:
"Halo 2A MP: In Anniversary matchmaking, earn a total of 100 Environmentalist medals."
[/code]
For this achievement you need to obtain 100 Environmentalist medals in Halo 2A matchmade games. Environmentalist medals are earned from killing enemies with falling ice on the map Lockdown and also from exploding fusion coils that result in a kill. This one is grindy so good luck. :D

[b]1v1 Method:[/b] This can be earned 1v1 by you and a friend queuing up in separate lobbies at the same time. Hope for the map Lockdown or other Forge maps that have fusion coils and hanging ice.
[previewicon=30049075;sizeThumb,inline;environ.png][/previewicon]

sub_sections.title: Halo 2 - Classic [previewimg=30049131;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;25 ice.jpg][/previewimg]
sub_sections.description_text:
[b]All these achievements can be unlocked in Custom Games and do not have to be achieved in Matchmade games.[/b]
[code]
[previewimg=19961154;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;anim.jpg][/previewimg]
-Animal Habitat:
"Halo 2: Spot the hippo on the walls of Headlong in classic multiplayer."
[/code]
Find the Hippo on the multiplayer map Headlong on the yellow walls. Here is a video by Halo Completionist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-SBQ6MSRZCg
[code]
[previewimg=19961157;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;sid.jpg][/previewimg]
-Sid Graffiti:
"Halo 2: Spot the Sid graffiti on the walls of Coagulation in classic multiplayer."

[previewimg=19961164;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;why 2.jpg][/previewimg]
-Why So Serious:
"Halo 2: View the smiling face in the classic multiplayer map Coagulation."
[/code]
These two achievements are easter eggs on the same multiplayer map, Coagulation. Here is a video guide by Halo Completionist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=StjEUoD4AJo
[code]
[previewimg=19961165;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;why.jpg][/previewimg]
-Why Am I Here?:
"Halo 2: View this hidden message on the classic Beaver Creek map."
[/code]
This easter egg is located on the map Beaver Creek at the top of one of the rocky walk ways behind a couple of loose boulders. Here is a video guide by Halo Completionist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cUIP7BVFNEI
[code]
[previewimg=19961159;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;siege.jpg][/previewimg]
-Siege of Ivory Tower:
"Halo 2: Listen to a hidden music cue in Halo 2."
[/code]
This hidden easter egg is located on the map Ivory Tower and can be unlocked by crouching in the corner at the back of the map by the elevator. Here is a video guide by Halo Completionist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EAUbvLX7LkA
[code]
[previewimg=19961156;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;destination.jpg][/previewimg]
-Destination Vacation:
"Halo 2: View one of the seasonal signs on Zanzibar in classic multiplayer."
[/code]
This achievement is unlocked by viewing one of the signs on the beach area of the map Zanzibar on one of the following days:
[list]
[*] January 1st - New Year's Day
[*] July 7th - Bungie Day
[*] October 31st - Halloween
[*] December 25th - Christmas
[/list]
If you do not wish to wait for one of these dates you can change your PC's date and achieve it that way.
[code]
[previewimg=19961163;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;tourist.jpg][/previewimg]
-Tourist:
"Halo 2: Complete a match on at least 8 different classic multiplayer maps."
[/code]
Pretty self-explanatory. You can load up different maps in custom games and then end the game straight away.
[code]
[previewimg=19961167;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;window.jpg][/previewimg]
-Window Shopping:
"Halo 2: Complete a match on at least 4 different game types in classic multiplayer."
[/code]
Can be down with the achievement above. Load up custom games with different game types selected. Just change the game type in the custom game selection i.e. Capture the Flag, Slayer etc.

sub_sections.title: Halo CE [previewimg=30049120;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;25 back in the day.jpg][/previewimg]
sub_sections.description_text:
[i][b]Note: None of the Halo CE multiplayer achievements require matchmade play and can be obtained in custom games.[/b][/i]

[code]
[previewimg=19942212;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;airborne.jpg][/previewimg]
-Airborne:
"Halo CE: Launch a Warthog for at least 5 seconds and have it splatter an enemy."
[/code]
This achievement can be a bit time consuming to get right and is most easily obtained on the map Death Island. You will need a friend or second player to obtain this achievement.

It is hard to explain the method in words so it would be best to refer to this video by Maka91Productions: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gXxdCq0UDwE
[code]
[previewimg=19942209;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;back in the day.jpg][/previewimg]
-Back in the Day:
"Halo: CE: Play a CTF custom game on Blood Gulch with 4 players. Tri-tip optional."
[/code]
For this achievement you need to start a custom game of Capture the Flag on the map Blood Gulch with 3 other players. Either find some friends or people willing to assist.

[code]
[previewimg=19942211;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;sightseeing.jpg][/previewimg]
-Sightseeing:
"Halo CE: Complete a match on at least 8 different classic multiplayer maps."
[/code]
Pretty self-explanatory. You can load up different maps in custom games and then end the game straight away.

[code]
[previewimg=19942205;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;cheking out.jpg][/previewimg]
-Checking Out Your Options:
"Halo CE: Complete a match on at least 4 unique game types."
[/code]
Can be down with the achievement above. Load up custom games with different game types selected. Just change the game type in the custom game selection i.e. Capture the Flag, Slayer etc.

sub_sections.title: Halo Reach [previewimg=30049122;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;25 edefd070c4c2e589f07c9e1b0493ba18b2963ed6.jpg][/previewimg]
sub_sections.description_text:
[h1]Matchmade Only:[/h1]
[code]
[previewimg=19942374;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;edefd070c4c2e589f07c9e1b0493ba18b2963ed6.jpg][/previewimg]
-Negative, Ghostrider:
"Halo: Reach: Get a Skullamanjaro in a matchmade Headhunter game."
[/code]
This achievement is awarded for getting a Skullamanjaro medal in the Headhunter gamemode. A Skullamanjaro is obtained by scoring ten skulls at once. This initially sounds hard but if you play team headhunter, when you or someone gets this medal on your team, you will get the achievement.
[code]
[previewimg=19942384;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;skunked.jpg][/previewimg]
-Skunked:
"Halo: Reach: Won a matchmade game of Invasion in the 1st phase."
[/code]
Play a standard game of invasion in Halo Reach and as the defending team, successfully defend the two marked territories to unlock the achievement. Can only be obtained as the defending team and in a matchmade game.

[h1]Obtainable in Custom:[/h1]
[code]
[previewimg=19942366;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;confused.jpg][/previewimg]
-Confused Callouts:
"Halo: Reach: Trigger a humorous callout on your HUD's position indicator."
[/code]
This is awarded for encountering a special location callout in a Multiplayer map. Can be obtained on Boardwalk by making your way to the location called 'Make Out Point'.

Here is a video guide by Maka91Productions if you need a little extra help: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IkzAuEhaNF4
[code]
[previewimg=19942373;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;easy.jpg][/previewimg]
-Easy to Overlook
"Halo: Reach: Access hidden UNSC radio chatter."
[/code]
Load up a custom game of Firefight on the map Overlook and head into the main base and go to the back of the upper floor and listen to the radio. These radios do appear on other multiplayer maps but this is a guaranteed method.

Here is a video guide by Maka91Productions if you need a little extra help:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=39E_h0g3HBU
[code]
[previewimg=19942382;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;runn.jpg][/previewimg]
-Run and Gunned:
"Halo: Reach: Headshot 10 enemies while they are sprinting."
[/code]
Headshot opponents when they are sprinting. Can be obtained easily in SWAT games due to headshots being instant kills. You can unlock this in Custom games as well as matchmade. You can easily tell when you have done one because a Headcase medal will display. Headcase medals look like a six pointed gold star with a purple skull on top with a white target in the centre.
[previewicon=30035798;sizeThumb,inline;Headcase_post_beta.png][/previewicon]
[code]
[previewimg=19942381;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;resq.jpg][/previewimg]
-Requiescat in Pace:
"Halo: Reach: Complete 10 assassinations on enemy players."
[/code]
This achievement is awarded by completing 10 assassinations on enemy players in Halo: Reach. Can be obtained from custom games and matchmade games. To assassinate a player, follow them from behind and hold down the melee button.
[code]
[previewimg=19942385;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;workers.jpg][/previewimg]
-Workers' Compensation:
"Halo: Reach: Splatter an enemy using the forklift."
[/code]
The easiest way to obtain this achievement is to load up custom Firefight on the map Courtyard on Gruntpocalypse and set the starting weapon to a gravity hammer. Load into the game and use the gravity hammer to smash the forklift into a grunt and obtain the achievement.

Here is a video guide by Maka91Productions if you need a little extra help:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m7FLRR0qBk8
[code]
[previewimg=19942368;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;cap.jpg][/previewimg]
-Capacious Cartography:
"Halo: Reach: Create a custom map using Forge World."
[/code]
Load up a game of Forge in Halo Reach (under the Create tab on the menu) and choose the map Forge World. Once in save the map as any name and the achievement will unlock.
[code]
[previewimg=19942376;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;enemies.jpg][/previewimg]
-Enemies Everywhere!:
"Halo: Reach: Complete a Firefight set on Normal or Harder."
[/code]
Completing a matchmade game of firefight in Halo Reach is the easiest and quickest way to unlock this achievement, although it can also be obtained in custom Firefight.

sub_sections.title: Cross-Game [previewimg=30049119;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;25 aim.jpg][/previewimg]
sub_sections.description_text:
[h1]Custom games:[/h1]
[i][b]Note: Some of these achievements can be obtained and have progression gained towards in matchmade games as well.[/b][/i]
[code]
[previewimg=19960977;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;aim.jpg][/previewimg]
-Aim for the Head:
"Earn a total of 2,500 Headshot medals in multiplayer."
[/code]
This achievement is for 2,500 headshots in multiplayer. Progress can be gained from both matchmade and custom games and will likely unlock by natural multiplayer play.
[previewicon=30049154;sizeThumb,inline;1 headshot 4.png][/previewicon] [previewicon=30049153;sizeThumb,inline;1 headahot 3a.png][/previewicon]
[code]
[previewimg=19961065;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;nice.jpg][/previewimg]
-Nice Work Dawg!:
"Earn a total of 2,500 Assist medals in multiplayer."
[/code]
This achievement is for 2,500 assist medals in multiplayer. Progress can be gained from both matchmade and custom games and will likely unlock by natural multiplayer play. Spartan Ops also grants progress towards this achievement. [strike]Note that Halo 3 does not grant assist medals.[/strike]
Halo 3 does now count after a recent update.
[previewicon=30049187;sizeThumb,inline;1 assist.png][/previewicon] [previewicon=30049188;sizeThumb,inline;1 assist 2.png][/previewicon]
[code]
[previewimg=19960978;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;dim mak.jpg][/previewimg]
-Dim Mak:
"Earn a total of 250 Beat Down medals in multiplayer."
[/code]
Beat Down medals are awarded for killing an enemy with a melee from behind (that does not result in an assassination). These can be earned in matchmade and custom games and even Firefight games.
[code]
[previewimg=19942130;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;mystery.jpg][/previewimg]
-Mystery Achievement:
"Inscrutable. Mysterious."
[/code]
For this achievement go to the custom games multiplayer page for Halo CE and save a custom game variant with the name '[b].fortune[/b]' and the achievement will unlock.

[i]Although the achievement is unlocked from the Halo CE page it counts as cross-game within the MCC.[/i]

[code]
[previewimg=19961051;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;killed.jpg][/previewimg]
-The Guardians Are Coming:
"Get killed by the Guardians."
[/code]
This is awarded by being killed in a manner which is unrecognizable to the game engine. For example, getting killed by environmental objects (such as the train on the Halo 2 multiplayer map Terminal).
[code]
[previewimg=19942173;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;custom games.jpg][/previewimg]
-Game Master:
"Created and saved 5 Custom Game types."
[/code]
Like the above achievement, save 5 custom game files for this achievement. Can be obtained in any Halo game.
[code]
[previewimg=19942173;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;custom games.jpg][/previewimg]
-Master Forger:
"Created and saved 5 Custom Maps in Forge."
[/code]
Save 5 maps in the Forge gamemode accessible from the main menu under the 'Create' menu.

[h1]Matchmade:[/h1]
[code]
[previewimg=19941974;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;double.jpg][/previewimg]
-Double Trouble:
"Earn a total of 250 Double Kill medals in matchmade games."
[/code]
Double Kill medals are earned for killing 2 opponents within 4 seconds of each other. This medal is represented by a gold circle with 2 blue stars. This will most likely unlock naturally by playing most matchmade gamemodes and is not that hard to obtain.
Double Kill medals earned in matchmade Firefight do count towards the achievement.
[code]
[previewimg=19941985;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;spree.jpg][/previewimg]
-Spree Master:
"Earn a total of 100 Killing Spree medals in matchmade games."
[/code]
Killing Spree medals are earned for killing 5 opponents in one life (without dying). Dying resets the counter. This medal is represented by a steel 4-sided star with a cyan target in the middle. This will most likely unlock naturally by playing most matchmade gamemodes and is not that hard to obtain. Can be easier on objective gamemodes if you are struggling cause opponents attention will most likely be on objectives rather than you.
Killing Spree medals earned in matchmade Firefight do NOT count towards the achievement.
[code]
[previewimg=19941989;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;party.jpg][/previewimg]
-Party Pooper:
"Earn a total of 250 Killjoy medals in matchmade games."
[/code]
Killjoy medals are earned for ending another persons killing spree. This medal is represented by a smiling face with a red line through it. Just play lots of multiplayer games or alternatively if you wanted you could find someone to farm it with in 1v1 gamemodes.
[code]
[previewimg=19941998;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;catch.jpg][/previewimg]
-Catch This:
"Earn a total of 500 Grenade Kill or Plasma Kill medals in matchmade games."
[/code]
It's worth noting that sticking someone with a plasma grenade does not count towards the achievement. Also avoid Halo 3 and Halo Reach when aiming for this achievement because they do not have grenade kill medals.
[code]
[previewimg=19941982;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;domination.jpg][/previewimg]
-Domination:
"Earn a total of 100 Legendary medals in matchmade games."
[/code]
There are six legendary medals in Halo MCC which are:
[list]
[*] [b]Steaktacular [/b]- achieved by winning a slayer match with at least 20 kills more than the opposing team.
[*] [b]Extermination [/b]- achieved by killing the last alive player on the opposing team with at least an Overkill that results in the entire team being dead at once.
[*] [b]Killionaire [/b]- awarded for killing ten opponents within four seconds of each other.
[*] [b]Perfection [/b]- awarded for winning a Slayer game with at least 15 kills, and without dying.
[*] [b]Triple Double[/b] - earned by finishing a game with double-digit kills, assists, and headshots.
[*] [b]Unfriggenbelievable [/b]- awarded for killing 40 enemies in a row without dying.
[/list]
Firefight variants do NOT count for the achievement.
[code]
[previewimg=19941992;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;planting.jpg][/previewimg]
-Planting A Flag:
"Earn a total of 250 CTF Mode Specific medals in matchmade games."
[/code]
Unlocked by earning a total of 250 Capture the Flag mode-specific medals. CTF mode specific medals are easiest obtained in Halo 2A and Halo 4 multiplayer. Medals included can be found under the career tab.
[code]
[previewimg=19941975;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;true king.jpg][/previewimg]
-The True King:
"Earn a total of 250 KOTH Mode Specific medals in matchmade games."
[/code]
Unlocked by earning a total of 250 King of the Hill mode-specific medals. Again, Halo 2A and Halo 4 contain the most KOTH medals.
[code]
[previewimg=19960966;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;bite.jpg][/previewimg]
-Bite The Hand:
"Kill a 343 developer in matchmaking or someone who has this achievement."
[/code]
Very easy and will unlock probably after a single matchmade game.
